Definition: of uncertain derivation; Crete, an island in the Mediterranean:--Crete.
BiblicalUsage: Crete is the great island in the Mediterranean where Paul's ship was driven in the storm and where Titus was left to finish the work. In Acts 27:7, Acts 27:12, and Acts 27:13 the ship sails under Crete and along its coast, in Acts 27:21 Paul reminds the crew they should not have loosed from Crete, and in Titus 1:5 he tells Titus he left him there to ordain elders in every city.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced Crete matters because the gospel took root in hard soil: a people known for lying heard the truth, and elders were ordained in every city anyway. The gospel took root in hard soil, and it can take root in mine.
